record.title: Plan-gate bypass: store owner address leaks via pattern documents and /r/maps/ redirect on plans without has_location_map
record.description: StorePublicSerializer.get_location_address correctly requires customization.show_location AND profile_has_benefit(user,'has_location_map') AND user.address (serializers.py:800-817), but two other anonymous public surfaces re-derive the same PII without the benefit check. (1) pattern_render.build_store_context sets address = user.address whenever customization.show_location is true (pattern_render.py:1145) — no has_location_map check — and exposes it as store_address (:1172) plus store_maps_url = contact_redirect_path(store,'maps') (:1172/:1182); _page_flags 'location' (:236) and the flags_css hiding (:1818-1821) key only on show_*, never on plan. DesignPattern.render (design/models/models.py:358-380) substitutes {{store_address}} into the HTML served by GET /api/stores/public/<slug>/pattern/document/ and /pattern/; ~16 sources/*.html templates interpolate it, including 'esencial' — the platform DEFAULT_PATTERN (seed.py:56) and a tier-'base' pattern allowed on Plan basico. (2) contact_redirect_url kind=='maps' (contact.py:162-173) builds https://maps.google.com/?q=<user.address>,<city>,<province> from raw UserProfile.address with zero gates — it does not even check show_location — and is reachable via public_contact (viewset.py:689-711) which only requires is_published+is_blocked+has_public_link. Compounding: show_location defaults True (models.py:243) and the customization PATCH discards LOCATION_FIELDS=('show_location',) for plans without has_location_map (viewset.py:119-121,1398-1399), so a Plan basico owner cannot disable the toggle at all. Plan basico is seeded with has_public_link=True, has_customization=True, has_location_map=False (SuscriptionApp seeds.py:45-73), so every published basico store leaks the owner's EncryptedCharField business domicilio to anonymous visitors. Correction to the hunter's framing: expired/lapsed subscriptions yield empty plan_benefits_of() so has_public_link fails and all public routes 404 — the affected population is stores on an ACTIVE plan lacking has_location_map (Plan basico). The leak additionally requires a StoreCustomization row (auto-created by get_or_create on the dashboard's GET /api/stores/customization/, viewset.py:1391) and a non-empty user.address.
record.root_cause: The has_location_map plan gate is enforced only in StorePublicSerializer.get_location_address; pattern_render.build_store_context and stores/services/contact.py contact_redirect_url independently derive the owner address / maps URL from raw UserProfile.address + customization.show_location without consulting profile_has_benefit('has_location_map'), and the /r/maps/ branch does not even honor the owner's show_location toggle.
record.intended_behavior: Every public surface that exposes the owner street address or a maps deep-link must apply the same effective gate as the serializer: customization.show_location AND profile_has_benefit(store.user,'has_location_map') (and a non-empty address). The 'location' page flag and data-flag zones should hide on the same predicate.

trace.description: Anonymous GET /api/stores/public/<slug>/r/<kind>/ (AllowAny via PUBLIC_ACTIONS). Gates only is_published+is_blocked (lines 694-697) and profile_has_benefit 'has_public_link' (698-699); kind='maps' flows into contact_redirect_url with no show_location/has_location_map check.
Anonymous GET /api/stores/public/<slug>/pattern/document/ (and /pattern at :797) via _pattern_store (788-795): same published+unblocked+has_public_link gate only; no plan check on location data.
address = _text(user.address,160) whenever customization.show_location is true — no profile_has_benefit(...,'has_location_map') check, unlike the serializer's triple gate.
'location' flag keyed only on show_location; flags_css ([data-flag] display:none, lines 1818-1821) hides location zones by owner toggle only — plan benefit never consulted.

store_address (:1172) and store_maps_url = contact_redirect_path(store,'maps') (:1182) enter the render context; DesignPattern.render (design/models/models.py:358-380) substitutes {{store_address}} into the HTML served by /pattern and /pattern/document (escape() prevents markup injection, not disclosure).
kind=='maps' builds https://maps.google.com/?q=<user.address>,<city>,<province> from raw UserProfile.address — zero gates: no has_location_map benefit and not even customization.show_location.

evidence.description: get_location_address enforces the intended gate: returns None unless customization.show_location AND profile_has_benefit(store.user,'has_location_map') AND user.address (lines 800-817).
LOCATION_FIELDS = ('show_location',); discarded from PATCH payload when the plan lacks has_location_map (lines 1398-1399) — basico owners cannot turn the toggle off.
show_location = BooleanField(default=True); comment (238-242) states the intent that without the benefit 'la web pública no lo renderiza' — violated by the pattern/redirect paths.
UserProfile.address is an EncryptedCharField (AES-256-GCM at rest) — treated as protected PII whose plaintext is decrypted on attribute access.
Plan basico: has_public_link=True (:48), has_customization=True (:59), has_location_map=False (:60) — the exact affected plan combination.

DesignPattern.render returns escape(str(context[name])) for declared variables — store_address is declared via PATTERN_VARIABLES (pattern_render.py:47) and sources/*.html usage, so the plaintext address lands in served HTML.

{{store_address}} interpolated into served pattern HTML; esencial is tier 'base' (seed_data.json) and DEFAULT_PATTERN (design/seed.py:56) — resolvable by basico-plan stores via template 'raiz'/'esencial'.

profile_has_benefit/plan_benefits_of derive benefits only from a subscription with grants_access(); expired plans yield {} so has_public_link fails and public routes 404 — scoping the bug to active low-tier plans.

conditions.description: None — both endpoints are AllowAny public actions (PUBLIC_ACTIONS, viewset.py:424,445-453).

Store is_published=True, is_blocked=False; owner has an ACTIVE subscription granting has_public_link but NOT has_location_map (Plan basico per seeds.py:45-73); UserProfile.address non-empty; a StoreCustomization row exists (auto-created by get_or_create on GET /api/stores/customization/, viewset.py:1391) with show_location=True — the default, which basico owners cannot change because PATCH discards LOCATION_FIELDS.

For the pattern-document path the resolved DesignPattern markup must reference {{store_address}} (true for the default 'esencial' and ~15 other sources); the /r/maps/ path needs only a non-empty address/city/province and leaks even when show_location=False.

execution.attacker_perspective: Anonymous internet user who knows or discovers a published store slug (slugs are public via sitemap.xml, shared links, and the public catalog).
instructions: Enumerate published store slugs (sitemap.xml, public catalog, shared store links).

For each slug on a plan without has_location_map (Plan basico), request GET /api/stores/public/<slug>/pattern/document/ and search the returned HTML for the address block rendered from {{store_address}} (e.g. 'Dirección', 'Cómo llegar' rows); alternatively GET /api/stores/public/<slug>/pattern/ and inspect the 'html' field of the JSON.
Request GET /api/stores/public/<slug>/r/maps/ and read the 302 Location header — it contains https://maps.google.com/?q=<street address>,<city>,<province> even when the owner set show_location=False.
execution.observed_result: Source-derived (no runtime execution): build_store_context populates store_address from user.address whenever customization.show_location is true with no plan check, so the pattern JSON/document HTML contains the plaintext business address; contact_redirect_url('maps') returns a Google Maps URL embedding the raw address with zero gates, so /r/maps/ 302s to it for any published+unblocked store with has_public_link — including Plan basico stores where StorePublicSerializer.location_address is null.

remediation.strategy: Apply the serializer's effective gate everywhere the address/maps URL is derived: require customization.show_location AND profile_has_benefit(store.user,'has_location_map') in build_store_context for address/store_maps_url and in the 'location' page flag; gate contact_redirect_url kind=='maps' (or public_contact) on the same benefit plus show_location. Consider a data migration or read-time coercion setting show_location=False for stores whose plan lacks has_location_map, since basico owners cannot clear it via PATCH.

likelihood.reason: Deterministic unauthenticated disclosure via single GETs on every published Plan basico store with an address; basico is a standard paid tier, show_location defaults True and cannot be disabled without the benefit, and the default 'esencial' pattern bakes {{store_address}} for essentially every store.

impact.reason: Unauthenticated disclosure of the owner's EncryptedCharField business domicilio (treated as plan-gated PII) plus circumvention of a paid-plan monetization gate and of the owner's own visibility toggle; no credentials, payment data, or cross-tenant access.

confidence.reason: Every link verified end-to-end in source: the serializer gate, the ungated build_store_context derivation, {{store_address}} interpolation through DesignPattern.render into served HTML, the zero-gate maps redirect, the AllowAny entrypoints, the LOCATION_FIELDS write-discard, show_location default, EncryptedCharField storage, and the Plan basico benefit matrix. Only runtime data-state (address populated, customization row present) is assumed, which is the normal case for managed stores.
